<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

`pij pod export <pod> --as-template <path>` writes a running or closed pod, with any seat added while it ran, as a template at a path; a role can be saved as a role template with named parameters; the view suggests saving one when the same role or group is made a second time.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A repo grows its own templates from what it actually ran.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Sharing a template back into pij (by pull request, PRD 010 q-01).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: one write per export; the view's suggestion is computed when the view is asked. No loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
